title: Relative Viscosity Measurement Protocol
author: Alison Lovegrove
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.babqiamw
materials: Switch on PC, AVS370 and water bath.
Open WinVisco software and wait until it has found hardware then click OK.
In System maintenance check that “pressing” is selected.
Select AVS Center and methods/results tab.

The software is set up so that data is routed to the user’s H:\drive. Each sample generates a PDF file and a csv (comma separated values) file which needs to be opened on this PC and saved as an excel file so that it opens correctly on other PCs. (A consequence of the nice German software and our refusal to use commas to separate values!)

steps.title: Prepare aqueous flour extract
steps.instruction: Prepare triplicate samples of wheat flour extract using Falcon tubes.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 1 g of flour into 15 ml Falcon tubes and add 4 ml water (alternatively, use 0.75 g flour and 3 ml water).
Vortex thoroughly to ensure the sample is completely suspended.
Agitate the sample for 15 min on Spiramix.
Centrifuge for 10 min at maximum speed (5,000 rpm) in an Eppendorf benchtop centrifuge.

steps.title: Heat and clarify extract
steps.instruction: Heat the supernatant and remove flocculated proteins.

substeps.instruction: Immediately transfer the supernatant to a clean Falcon tube and place in a boiling water bath for 10 min.
Centrifuge for 5 min at maximum speed (5,000 rpm).
Transfer supernatant to 15 ml Corex tubes (use paired tubes of approximately the same weight; do not adjust volume).
Centrifuge at 10,000g for 10 min to sediment flocculated proteins.

steps.title: Filter sample
steps.instruction: Filter the clarified extract into a clean tube using 0.45um Millex PVDF disposable filters.

steps.title: Prepare AVS370 viscometer
steps.instruction: Set up the hardware and software for viscosity measurement.

substeps.instruction: Set temperature on CT72 to 30°C (or desired temperature), press enter to start the water bath, and wait for it to reach the set temperature.
Ensure the capillary is clean; if necessary, force hot water followed by bulk acetone through and dry by vacuum.
Log on to the PC with username and password.
Set language options according to the sheet by the PC.
In viskosimeters, select V1 cap 1 1052006, Mikro Ostwald with a constant of 0.0114.
Select Operator = User and log on using password: AVS370.

steps.title: Run blank measurement
steps.instruction: Perform a blank run at the start of every run to calibrate the instrument.

substeps.instruction: Load the blank method and run (click start/stop) using 2 ml distilled water.
Accept the new blank measurement (should be approximately 71s).
Ensure the capillary in its stand is correctly inserted into the instrument and tubing is correctly attached to prevent sample leakage.

steps.title: Measure sample viscosity
steps.instruction: Run the wheat extract samples through the viscometer.

substeps.instruction: Select method (aq. extract wheat), enter sample ID, and run samples.
Optionally select the Overview tab and check the 'show activity status' box to monitor progress.
Thoroughly wash the capillary (using hot water and bulk acetone) between each sample.
